skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK DMG (+10) to a single target, and increases own max HP by 20% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks each enemy in the entire row with 3 combo strikes, dealing DMG based on 30% of the main target's max HP (+bonus) (capped at 30% of Hellfire Flame's max HP). Has a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 30% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks each enemy in the entire row with 3 combo strikes, dealing DMG based on 40% of the main target's max HP (+bonus) (capped at 40% of Hellfire Flame's max HP). Has a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 40% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP (+20). At battle start, grants [Tenacity Boost] to self and surrounding allies for 2 turns (makes [Resilience/Tenacity] absorb DoT and Injury-type DMG: Injury/Internal Injury/Charge). At the start of each turn, grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 20% of Hellfire Flame's HP).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP (+20). At battle start, grants [Tenacity Boost] to your entire team for 2 turns (makes [Resilience/Tenacity] absorb DoT and Injury-type DMG: Injury/Internal Injury/Charge). At the start of each turn, grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 25% of Hellfire Flame's HP).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP (+20). At battle start, grants [Tenacity Boost] to your entire team for 3 turns (makes [Resilience/Tenacity] absorb DoT and Injury-type DMG: Injury/Internal Injury/Charge). At the start of each turn, grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 30% of Hellfire Flame's HP).

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
